Question 12
?

Find the domain of the function z=x3ln⁡(x2−y2).

a
The domain is the entire xy-plane
b
{(x,y)∈R2:x2−y2>0,x2−y2≠1}
c
{(x,y)∈R2:x2−y2>0}
d
{(x,y)∈R2:x2−y2≠0,1}
e
{(x,y)∈R2:x2−y2>1}
